RESULT.md proves exact full curve, mixture robustness, and unbounded connected motif extension.
value.rationale: This is a motivated counterexample to monotonicity in an adaptive epidemiological mechanism: simultaneous exposures trigger protective behaviour and close a gate, whereas a lone source spreads through a downstream clique. The eight-vertex case is the smallest viable member of a canonical two-bridge gated-clique family and supplies an exact strictly unimodal benchmark. The social-layer-independent open awareness-mixing wedge and infinite connected family show the result is not a finely tuned single experiment or an arbitrary tabulated slice. It answers a natural modelling question left qualitative in simulations: can local-risk response alone cause stronger transmission to yield fewer expected infections?
